eventDetail.scope: The 11th IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Computer Science and Data Engineering (CSDE 2026) is an international forum that promotes research, innovation, and collaboration in computer science and data engineering. The conference will be held in hybrid mode, enabling participation from researchers, academics, industry professionals, and students worldwide.  CSDE 2026 aims to facilitate knowledge exchange on emerging technologies and modern computing solutions. The conference will feature keynote speeches, technical paper presentations, workshops, and tutorials covering topics such as artificial intelligence, machine learning, big data analytics, cloud computing, cybersecurity, and software engineering.  By bringing together experts from academia and industry, the conference encourages interdisciplinary collaboration and supports the development of innovative digital technologies to address real-world challenges.
